descriptions.lobby: Say hi! The main room for everything PokéIQ. Stuck or new? Ask here and other trainers will help.
descriptions.pokedle: The daily Pokémon guessing game: share your score, not the answer.
descriptions.connections: Four hidden groups, sixteen Pokémon: share your grid and talk about the tricky ones.
descriptions.pikadoku: Pokémon Sudoku: compare rare picks and brag about your rarity score.
descriptions.pokeguessr: Where in the Pokémon world was that? Share streaks and great guesses.
descriptions.battle: Random Battles, OU, Little Cup and every format: teams, sets, big plays and comebacks.
descriptions.quizzes: Who's That Pokémon, Name 'em All and every quiz: share scores and challenge each other.
